why_ai: Platform software matching remote work, much of which AI itself now substitutes.
why_clarity: Transactions repeat at scale, but allocation quality and ratings are opaque.
why_digital: Fully online marketplace with freelancers routinely abroad.

why_ai: Small-sum disputes decided from message threads; evidence assembly automates well.
why_clarity: Who should get the money is rarely verified after the decision.
why_digital: Message threads and deliverables in, payout decisions out, all online.

why_ai: An adaptive adversary keeps manipulation detection a moving, judgment-heavy contest.
why_clarity: Adversaries adapt, so whether a signal resists gaming is never settled.
why_digital: Platform signals analysed and defended entirely in software.

why_ai: Identity checks are automated; capability verification is hard but software-bound.
why_clarity: Every newcomer goes through the same flow, but true skill is hard to confirm.

why_ai: The most solved layer; only a residue of compliance classification remains.
why_clarity: Money either arrives correctly or it does not.
why_digital: Escrow and multi-rail payouts run entirely on payment infrastructure.

why_ai: Predicting whether a job will be awarded is a standard model over platform data.
why_clarity: Job award is an observable binary outcome across huge volume.
why_digital: Job posts and proposals handled entirely online.

why_ai: Already automated end to end by the platform ranker.
why_clarity: Rankings run constantly, but whether they produce good engagements is weakly measured.
why_digital: Search and matching computed and shown in software.

why_ai: Explanations are computable from the ranker, with emerging regulatory pressure.
why_clarity: Explanations derive from scoring, but their usefulness to freelancers is unmeasured.
why_digital: Ranker data in, explanations out on the platform.

why_ai: Rater calibration is a well-posed statistical problem on held data.
why_clarity: Calibration is a defined statistical task over many ratings.
why_digital: Ratings data in, calibrated scores out on profiles.

why_ai: Business instruments for freelancers are derivations from records already held.
why_clarity: Income, pipeline and tax figures derive from exact platform records.
why_digital: Platform records in, dashboards and forecasts out, all online.

why_ai: Account suspensions against adaptive fraud are consequential decisions platforms keep human.
why_clarity: Wrong suspensions and clearances are rarely confirmed afterward.
why_digital: Flagged account evidence reviewed in browser queues.
